title: 9-to-5ers, after office:
5 free websites that
feel *illegal* to know
slides.sub: One per slide. Free, real, checked. Best one saved for last.

slides.name: remove*.bg*
slides.line: Cuts the background out of any photo in a few seconds.

rows.v: Profile photos, slides, office ID pictures
Free at preview size. HD uses paid credits.
A clean LinkedIn photo on a plain colour

slides.catch: Free file is small. Fine on screen, not print.

slides.name: Tiny*Wow*
slides.line: Merge, compress and convert PDFs, images and videos in your browser.

rows.v: Free with ads. Free use has limits.
Merge this month's bills into one PDF

slides.catch: Keep salary slips and office files off upload sites.

slides.name: Photo*pea*
slides.line: A Photoshop-style editor that runs free in your browser and opens PSD files.

rows.v: Free with ads. Premium removes them.
Open the designer's PSD, fix one line yourself

slides.catch: Free version shows ads beside your canvas.

slides.name: Perplex*ity*
slides.line: Answers your question and shows the sources it used as numbered links.

rows.v: Free plan. Pro searches are limited on it.

slides.box: Compare the top 3 project management tools for a 10-person team in India. Give the price in rupees where the site lists one, and link the source for every price.
slides.catch: Open the sources before a number goes in your deck.

slides.name: Notebook*LM*
slides.line: Add your PDFs, docs or notes. It answers from them and cites where.

rows.v: It quotes your file, so you can check
Long reports, policy docs, training material
Free with a Google account. Limits apply.

slides.box: Summarise this report in 5 bullet points for my manager. Then list 3 questions they are likely to ask, with the answer and where in the file each one comes from.
slides.catch: Check your company's rules before uploading work files.

slides.title: Save this *list.*
items: NotebookLM (my favourite): answers from your files
The catch: free tiers change. Check the limit before work depends on it.
